task: Start rpc-statd at boot on every Kubernetes node so containerized NFS CSI mounts work after node reboot.

events.summary: Issue #246 and shared node prerequisites were reviewed. The common prerequisite script is used by both standard provisioning and the Kakao provider path, covering masters and workers.
After node reboot, NFS PVC mounts fail because the host rpc-statd remains inactive while mount.nfs runs inside the CSI node-plugin container.
evidence: mount.nfs: rpc.statd is not running but is required for remote locking.

events.summary: Shared node prerequisites install an rpc-statd drop-in with rpcbind/network-online ordering and add rpc-statd as a multi-user.target want. systemctl add-wants is used because systemd.unit documents [Install] as enable-time metadata while not guaranteeing that [Install] in a drop-in makes a static unit enable-able. The start command is idempotent and the service is started immediately on install.

Static regression confirms the drop-in, boot dependency and immediate start are present in the common setup. Its mutation removes the add-wants command and the checker rejects the mutated configuration.

events.scope: Live node reboot on the lead's cluster
events.summary: The per-node live verifier is provided. Rebooting nodes and confirming RPC statd remains active with its multi-user.target wants link is pending for the lead.

Lead live run: the verifier passed every node (kubectl debug returns 0 without -i, and even with -i does not propagate the container exit code: live 'exit 3' -> kubectl_rc=0; default namespace was also Kyverno-denied). Now a node-printed sentinel decides, the debug pod runs in kube-system (policy-exempt) and is cleaned up.

events.scope: live six-node cluster, real reboot of worker-3
events.summary: Applied the 01-prerequisites statd block on worker-3 (symlink created), rebooted it with vagrant reload: after boot rpc-statd=active and rpcbind=active with no manual start, and worker-3's NFS-backed pods came up (before the fix every node had statd inactive after reboot and all NFS mounts failed). The fixed verifier discriminated: 5 FAIL (no boot link) + worker-3 PASS, rc=1; after applying the block to the other nodes: 6/6 PASS, rc=0.
evidence: runtime:vagrant reload worker-3 => statd=active rpcbind=active after boot
runtime:kubectl debug 'exit 3' => kubectl_rc=0 (exit code not propagated)

events.summary: The implementation, static mutation regression, requested local shell checks, and trace gates are complete. Live reboot verification is explicitly assigned to the lead as a follow-up.
Requested implementation and local verification are complete; lead live reboot verification remains pending as a follow-up.
